scientific_integrity: All-parameter analytic proof; finite checker is supplementary, not an exhaustive mathematical proof; earlier fixed-equal-noise n=2 and noiseless cases are acknowledged as prior special cases.
scientific_limitations: Unit-variance centered Brownian-bridge prior on [0,1]; independent Gaussian point-sensor errors; fixed total inverse-variance precision; target is one scalar integral; no adaptive or unequal-cost claim; publication priority incompletely resolved.
title: Universal optimal sensing meshes under a Brownian-bridge precision budget
